name: Better Tomorrow Ventures (BTV)

stage: Pre-seed and seed accepted. Evidence: btv.vc/about says the firm backs 'pre-seed and seed-stage fintech companies globally'. VCSheet lists Pre-Seed and Seed.
geography: Global, San Francisco based, strong US focus
best_channel: Warm intro from a fintech founder or a public DM to Sheel Mohnot (@pitdesi); no pitch form or email is published on btv.vc.
cold_pitch_policy: no public statement found (aggregators VCSheet and Superscout say 'warm intro' is preferred)
notes: Leads pre-seed rounds. Portfolio on btv.vc/companies with trading/crypto/AI relevance: Caplight (pre-IPO stock data and trading infrastructure), Capa (crypto rails for LatAm), Caliza (US-dollar access API), Unit (embedded banking), Deck (alternative data), Monk and Basis (AI). No prediction-market company seen. Also invested in Ramp, Mercury, Deel per Superscout. Hosts 'Camp BTV' for portfolio founders.

name: FinTech Collective
sectors: Fintech: capital markets, wealth and asset management, banking, lending, payments, insurance, proptech, emerging markets, DeFi (dedicated $50M DeFi allocation per search results)
stage: Seed and Series A. Pre-seed NOT confirmed: fintech.io shows seed/Series A deals; VCSheet lists Seed, Series A, Series B+ (no pre-seed). Treat idea stage as unlikely.
geography: New York City HQ, London office; invests US, Europe, LatAm, Africa, India

name: QED Investors
type: VC firm (with pre-seed company-formation vehicles Belay and Fontes)
sectors: Fintech only: credit, lending, insurance, wealth, proptech, banking-as-a-service, embedded finance, Web3/crypto (per VCSheet)
stage: Pre-seed accepted through dedicated vehicles. Evidence: qedinvestors.com states QED 'works with founders and entrepreneurs on formation stage businesses at the Powerpoint stage through its Belay and its Fontes by QED vehicles'. Main early-stage fund targets Series A ($3-10M initial checks). Fontes is a $12M seed/pre-seed fund for Latin America (QED blog, May 2021). No 'QED Fintech Fellowship' found in this session.
check_size: Main fund: typical initial checks $3-10M; VCSheet lists $30K-$20M overall; Belay/Fontes pre-seed amounts not published
geography: Global (27 countries); HQ Alexandria, Virginia; US, Europe, LatAm, India, Africa
pitch_email_or_form: https://www.qedinvestors.com/ (pitch form on the homepage; accepts .pptx or .pdf deck up to 10 MB)
best_channel: Submit the homepage form with a deck; also DM investment team members on LinkedIn or X.
cold_pitch_policy: Homepage wording per fetch: 'Never too early to connect'; founders are encouraged to build a relationship before they raise.
notes: Founded by Capital One veterans Nigel Morris and Frank Rotman; 31 unicorns (Credit Karma, Nubank, Remitly). Belay (US) and Fontes (LatAm) fund companies from 'PowerPoint stage'. No public application page for Belay found; use the main form and name Belay in the note. No trading or prediction-market company seen in this session.

name: Ribbit Capital
sectors: Fintech only: AI-native finance, global commerce, infrastructure, wealth management, trading, crypto, money movement, identity, data, energy
stage: Seed to growth. Pre-seed NOT confirmed: ribbitcap.com does not state stages; VCSheet lists Seed, Series A, Series B+; Superscout says 'No pre-seed stage mentioned'. Idea stage is a poor fit.
best_channel: Warm intro only; the official site lists no email or form. Aggregators cite info@ribbitcap.com or founders@ribbitcap.com but these are not on the official site and conflict with each other.
cold_pitch_policy: no public statement found (VCSheet: 'Best way to get in touch: warm intro')
notes: Strong trading/crypto portfolio: Robinhood, Coinbase, Brex, PhonePe; 163+ active companies. Very relevant sector fit but the firm writes larger checks and does not show a pre-seed track. Contact and team pages give no email.

name: Anthemis
sectors: Fintech, insurtech, embedded finance, AI, climate fintech, proptech, Web3/crypto, health
stage: Pre-seed listed by VCSheet (Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A, Series B+). Official pitch page asks for the 'stage of your business' and does not exclude early stage; it does not name pre-seed explicitly.
check_size: $2-3M at seed, ~$10M at growth (VCSheet); not on official site
geography: London based; invests in UK, Europe, USA, LatAm
best_channel: Email pitch@anthemis.com with the six items the pitch page asks for in the email body; deck optional.
cold_pitch_policy: Official page: 'This guidance is given in the spirit of giving every entrepreneur who takes the time to make us aware of their company an equal chance of being considered.' Also: 'We prefer to receive this information in the body of the email, but also encourage pitch decks and executive summaries.'
notes: The pitch page warns not to lead with technology words ('blockchain' and 'GenAI' are 'how' not 'what'); lead with the market problem and say why Anthemis fits. Portfolio: Addition Wealth, yulife, Fifth Dimension AI, Cariqa. No prediction-market or trading-bot company seen. Founders Amy Nauiokas and Sean Park.

name: Clocktower Technology Ventures

sectors: Fintech first; also regeneration/climate and deep tech; portfolio includes capital-markets and crypto infrastructure
stage: Seed and pre-seed companies dominate the portfolio per the official homepage ('Early-stage'); VCSheet lists Seed, Series A, Series B+. Non-lead investor: it has led zero rounds, so a pre-seed founder needs a lead first.

best_channel: Warm intro to Ben Savage (LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/linksavage/) or email the group contact address; the venture site has only a contact section with no visible details.
notes: Relevant portfolio on official site: Omniex (crypto-asset operating platform, acquired by Gemini), Caplight (pre-IPO derivatives), Imperative Execution (ML-powered ATS), plus AI firms Galini, Sieve, Hyperplane, Casca. Deliberately non-lead co-investor; 500+ portfolio companies. Partners: Ben Savage, Adriana Pierelli; founder Steve Drobny.

type: VC firm with a program (formerly a venture studio / cohort program)

name: Polymarket Builders Program
type: grant program / builder program with weekly revenue share (no venture fund found)
sectors: Prediction markets: apps, trading bots, terminals, AI agents, and aggregators that route orders to Polymarket
stage: Idea and builder stage accepted: builder credentials are self-service. Evidence: docs say 'Open polymarket.com -> Settings -> Builders and copy your builder code'; no approval is needed to start. Grants require traction: 'a $2.5 million fund for teams that show product traction, not only raw volume' (quoted via PolyMart write-up of official material).
check_size: Grants $100-$75,000 per project from a $2.5M+ fund (Defiprime guide); plus weekly USDC rewards by attributed volume (about 0.5-1% of volume per third-party estimate) and gas subsidies
geography: Global (Polymarket restricts some jurisdictions, including US retail trading; check terms)
pitch_email_or_form: https://builders.polymarket.com/ has an 'Apply now' button (seen through a read proxy); the form URL behind it was not captured. Builder code: https://polymarket.com/settings?tab=builder. Developer Discord: https://discord.gg/polymarket (#devs).
best_channel: Get a builder code in Polymarket settings, route volume, then apply for a grant on builders.polymarket.com; follow @PolymarketBuild for grant rounds; ask in the Discord #devs channel.
cold_pitch_policy: Official docs (via proxy): 'A builder is a person, group, or organization that routes orders from users to Polymarket. If you've created a platform that allows users to trade on Polymarket through your system, this program is for you.'
notes: Direct fit for a Polymarket trading-bot builder. Leaderboard examples: Betmoar ($3.5M 1-month volume, $817M lifetime per Gate), PolyCop, Stand.trade, kreoapp, Semantic Layer (AI agents, $5M funded), PolyBro (AI research agent). Polymarket publishes an MIT-licensed AI agents repo at https://github.com/Polymarket/agents. Official domains (builders.polymarket.com, docs.polymarket.com) were blocked for direct fetch; data came through a read proxy and third-party guides.
